overview: Euclid DR1 strong-lens work dominates, with CNN/vision-transformer segmentation and a catalogue of 11,256 lenses. Other papers apply Gaussian-process and neural emulators to Hi-COLA and core-collapse supernova equations of state, plus unsupervised and symbolic methods on IllustrisTNG, FRB and LAMOST data, and generate FLAMINGO galaxy catalogues.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
Emulators and neural surrogates for simulations
Unsupervised and symbolic regression in astrophysics
ML for time-domain and high-energy instrumentation
